notes.title: Announcement for Version 1.7.0 "Rise to Power" Major Update
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Magistrates![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Since resuming updates in May and releasing the latest Version 1.6.0, we believe the current gameplay experience has been optimized to a relatively ideal state, with most known bugs resolved. Now, it’s time to introduce the brand-new gameplay we’ve been designing![/p][p][/p][h3]A [b]brand-new Career Mode[/b] is coming soon! Many players' long-awaited dream of [b]climbing the ranks[/b] is finally here~ We’re calling this major update the [b]"Rise to Power"[/b] version.[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]What will Career Mode offer? This isn’t just a simple promotion system—it’s a [b]roguelite-inspired challenge[/b]! Inspired by our upcoming title, [i]Southern Banquet[/i], this mode will feature [b]randomized elements[/b] and [b]unique gameplay variations[/b] in each session, promising a fresh and exciting city-building experience.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Of course, developing this new mode will require more time. Aside from critical bug fixes, we will [b]pause updates for the next two months[/b] to focus entirely on creating this new content. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Thanks for your patience and support — stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Major Update – Reshaping Rivers and Mountains (V1.3.0)
notes.content: [p]Dear Magistrates,[/p][p]After more than a month of development, the highly anticipated Version 1.3.0 update is finally here![/p][p]We’ve named this update “Reshaping Rivers and Mountains” because it primarily focuses on improving the core systems and performance of the game—such as housing structure and consumption, happiness calculation, storage mechanics, and more. Gameplay in the early stages has been significantly streamlined to address pacing and balance issues.[/p][p]Mid-to-late game optimizations, however, will need to wait for the next update—otherwise, we’d never finish QA testing! 😭[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues after updating, please leave a comment under this announcement.[/p][p]Below are the main changes in this update:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Resource Consumption & Storage System][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Resources are now categorized into Agricultural, Industrial, and Maritime types.[/p][/*][*][p]The cart-based transport system has been removed. Granaries, Warehouses, and the Trade Office now only increase their respective storage capacities.[/p][/*][*][p]Citizens will automatically collect resources from the nearest warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Resources consumed to maintain building operations are now directly deducted from warehouse stock.[/p][/*][*][p]If warehouse capacity is full or a resource exceeds the storage limit, related buildings will cease production.[/p][/*][*][p]Building consumption is now divided into four categories: Fixed, Food, Material, and Additional.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource consumption and effects of buildings like Cottages, Farmhouses, Tile Houses, Residences, Guest Houses, Inns, Tea Houses, Markets, Taverns, Theaters, and Mansions have been rebalanced. Check in-game for details.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Resource Drop Adjustments][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Resources dropped from demolished buildings, defeated enemies, and repelled bandits now go directly into storage—no more hauling by warehouse workers.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Construction Logic][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Improved pathfinding when building roads—now smarter and more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed transport capacity limit for builders. As long as resources are sufficient, each resource type only needs to be delivered once. A fixed construction time has been added instead.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Health][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Reworked how food affects health—now only selected resources determine the health value.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed both maximum change speed and target health values—health is now updated instantly and directly based on input.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Happiness][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Removed happiness range from all buildings. The formula for housing happiness has been redesigned. Different road types now provide different happiness bonuses.[/p][/*][*][p]Housing happiness can now exceed 100.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Commerce][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Removed the Tourism Index.[/p][/*][*][p]Taxes from Tea Houses, Inns, Markets, Taverns, Theaters, etc., now scale with the number of employed workers.[/p][/*][*][p]Criminals, visitor complaints, and street performers now directly affect tourist attraction, instead of the tourism index.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed tourism effects from immortals, advisors, buildings, case judgments, artifacts, and public opinion.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Commercial Buffs][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Buffs are no longer triggered by fixed building combinations. Now, all connected commercial buildings share a unified “Commercial Value”. When a building becomes inactive due to lacking resources, it will no longer contribute commercial value.[/p][/*][*][p]Each commercial building that serves tourists now has buffs based on commercial value.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffs are divided into three categories: increased spending, higher food delivery price, and greater tourist attraction.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher-tier buildings require greater commercial value to reach maximum buff level, and in return provide more value.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Buildings][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Houses now consume food, materials, and additional resources. You can choose which to provide, which will affect health, happiness, and income.[/p][/*][*][p]Guest Houses function similarly, affecting health, guest capacity, and foreign tax income.[/p][/*][*][p]Trade Office no longer handles cart transport—now it only provides maritime functions at a maintenance cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Temples and Taoist Shrines now support adjustable workforce.[/p][/*][*][p]Temples, Taoist Shrines, and Tianhou Temple consume offerings directly from storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Hunters now produce meat based on difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]Confucian Temple now consumes 1 meat jerky per praying scholar.[/p][/*][*][p]Landscape buildings no longer affect happiness range, but can attract tourists.[/p][/*][*][p]Charity Burial Grounds no longer require full staffing to send off the deceased and now support adjustable staff.[/p][/*][*][p]Theaters no longer need upgrades to unlock street performances. Each play triggers a street performance, and performance income now scales with staff count.[/p][/*][*][p]Relay Stations now properly show couriers using ox carts or horse-drawn carts, fixing visual inconsistencies.[/p][/*][*][p]Taverns and Theaters now have two new food delivery types.[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact Bureau artifacts no longer boost tourism index.[/p][/*][*][p]Official Kiln can now choose production outputs freely after research is unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Mass Graves reduce tourist attraction in the city.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Personnel][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Lumberjacks will now cancel tasks for unreachable trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the following roles: Householders (Homes), Gatekeepers (Confucian Temple), Clan Protectors (Ancestral Hall), Warehouse Clerks (Granaries), Storage Clerks (Warehouses), Overseers (Trade Office), Price Clerks (Exchange Bureau), Curators (Artifact Bureau), Managers (Retirement Home), Shrine Keepers (Tianhou Temple), Receptionists (Guest House), and Servants (Mansion).[/p][/*][*][p]Idle citizens will now occasionally stay at home instead of endlessly wandering the streets.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance when large numbers of enemies appear simultaneously.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Research][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Removed research that increased cart numbers for storage buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Trade Office research. New maritime research now boosts shipyard production speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Research for Blacksmiths and Kilns has been changed from reducing maintenance to increasing worker slots.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Wildlife][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Wild animals no longer spawn globally—now only appear near Hunters.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]\[Visuals & UI][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Improved notes.title: Update v1.2.1 & Important Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Governors,

Good news! We've fixed the bug that caused cargo and crew members to randomly disappear during sailing.

P.S.
We've recently received feedback about certain game features not working as intended. Upon investigation, many of these issues are related to outdated Mods. Since Mods don’t automatically adapt to newer game versions, using older Mods may lead to incompatibilities. We strongly recommend checking whether a Mod is still actively maintained before subscribing to it.

[b]Important Announcement[/b]

After our previous update, we noticed some players were concerned about the upcoming major update potentially making old save files incompatible. Since we didn’t fully explain the nature of the major update last time, some players might be confused as to why a save reset is necessary if it’s "just an experience optimization."

We’d like to take this opportunity to clarify what's coming and why it matters. Here are some of the key features currently in development:

1. Reworked warehouse system – removing the cumbersome supply-demand hauling mechanic.

2. Removed landlords from all residential buildings, increasing each citizen’s productivity and improving city efficiency.

3. Adjusted resource consumption logic for all housing, making resource usage more efficient and giving players more flexibility in resource management.

4. Optimized worker allocations across all existing buildings.

5. Redesigned happiness-related mechanics, allowing for more flexibility in managing population and resources.

6. Revamped commercial building buffs, removing strict combo requirements and offering more freedom in building layout.

7. Improved visual effects for water and fog.

8. Updated builder hauling logic and adjusted build time mechanics to fix the frustrating “construction lock” experience.

9. Rebuilt hunting mechanics and improved wildlife generation, which is expected to enhance performance and reduce lag.

We believe these changes will bring a major improvement to the overall gameplay experience. Our intention is to rebuild the core of the game, laying a solid foundation for future content such as the Maritime Expedition and Imperial Examination systems, which are already on our roadmap.

Yes, we acknowledge that this means older designs were far from perfect. With the experience we've gained since launch, we’re confident that we can make The Grand Estate (满庭芳) a much better, more polished, and more enjoyable game. But to do this properly, we need to rethink and rework some foundational systems.

That’s why we’ve decided that delivering a fresh new gameplay experience is our top priority. Older save files will remain compatible with the previous branch of the game, but they won’t be supported in the new update. Supporting old saves would require a massive amount of additional development effort—effort we feel is better spent on refining and enhancing the game itself.

We genuinely believe this new version of the game will offer a much richer experience, and we’re excited for you to explore this new and improved version of the Song Dynasty city you’ve come to love.

Of course, this is just our perspective as the developers. If you strongly disagree with this direction, feel free to leave your thoughts in the discussion forums. If a significant number of players voice their support for keeping save file compatibility, we’ll consider prioritizing that instead. However, please understand that this would double (or more) the time needed to roll out the planned updates.

We’ll continue to improve the game and do our best to address any issues that arise. Your feedback is always welcome.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Dear Players, our 1.2.0 version update is here!

Here are our new updates:

1. Fixed the issue of game crashes in some cases
2. Optimized the art effect of the gravel road
3. Implemented the function of road widening

Major update preview:

Starting from the next version, we will comprehensively optimize the underlying framework of the game, and make significant adjustments to the gameplay. Therefore, after the next version update is launched, we will open the old version branch, and all existing saves can only run in the old version. The new version requires reopening the save for gaming experience. We cannot directly troubleshoot mod-related crashes, but we encourage you to rate mods (👍/👎) on the Steam Workshop after testing them. This helps other players identify reliable content!

2. Creating Mods? Read This First!

Strongly recommended: Follow our [url=https://github.com/QuinShuai/ThrivingCitySongMod]Official Modding Guide[/url] for Advisors, Case-Solving, and Map Mods.

Skin mod templates are also available in the guide (though results may vary based on creator skill). Proper implementation ensures better experiences for all!

3. Version Compatibility Matters

Mods should specify the compatible game version in their descriptions if creators don’t plan to actively maintain them. This minimizes post-installation bugs.

4. On Official Mod Plans:
While we’re currently focused on core game optimizations and balance adjustments, we’ll revisit official mod expansions in future updates. Thank you for your understanding!

As always, your feedback fuels our progress. Let’s build a thriving modding community together!

notes.title: Bug Collection: Game will be updated soon!
notes.content:
First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the long wait.

Over the past year, our focus has been on porting and optimizing Thriving City: Song for mobile platforms, which unfortunately led to the PC version being put on hold. We are now ready to resume updates.

Current Priorities:

Bug Fixes:

We will prioritize collecting and resolving technical issues. If you encounter any bugs, please report them directly via this form: https://wj.qq.com/s2/15338785/b756/ .

Reports will be reviewed weekly. If an issue cannot be replicated, we may follow up via email for additional details.

Content Updates:

While our long-term update plan is still being refined, after addressing critical bugs, we aim to roll out major improvements first. These include:

Road Placement Logic & Zone Generation Optimizations (yes, those highly requested wide roads are finally coming!).

Gradual adjustments to balance and numerical systems based on recent feedback.

A Message from the Dev Team:

Thriving City: Song is our first game project, and we never intended to abandon it. However, after working on it from 2021 to 2024—up until its official launch—we found ourselves creatively fatigued. The endless cycle of development had left us feeling disconnected, even lost, unsure of how to proceed or what "completion" truly meant.

We chose to pause updates after addressing a batch of critical bugs. Around that time, we secured a publishing deal for the mobile version, which prompted us to refocus on streamlining the game for handheld platforms. Meanwhile, our studio expanded, launched new projects, and experimented with fresh ideas.

Now, with the mobile version optimized and new project demo nearing completion, we've regained clarity and accumulated valuable experience to continue this marathon. We're ready to return to Thriving City: Song with renewed energy and ideas, eager to resume building this Song Dynasty-inspired world alongside you all.

As a team of introverts, we've never been great at public communication. But with updates resuming, we wanted to share this honest reflection on our journey over the past year.

Thanks to all the players who love Majesty in the Thriving City: Song!

大家好，我们是《满庭芳：宋上繁华》的制作组。

自游戏上线后，我们接到了许许多多来自大家的反馈和建议。其中许多我们都已记录在案，准备接下来花3个月左右的时间全方位优化游戏的细节体验（详细优化列表见文章末尾）。当然，最近一边修Bug的同时也已经一边开始做一些小的优化点了，只是更多的大优化还是需要花更多的时间去打磨，还请大家耐心等待。我们也会一如既往地在更新日志中预告接下来的工作重点，及时同步开发进度，尽可能让每一位支持我们的玩家玩得安心，放心。

notes.title: 满庭芳测试活动正式关闭
notes.content:
各位县官们，七夕快乐呀~借着节日气氛，我们也准备在今晚6点关闭满庭芳的Demo哟（别在家打游戏了，都给我出去约会！）。
不过你们知道吗，虽然都是过七夕，但宋代的七夕和现在的七夕其实习俗不太一样哦，那时大宋的子民们更多把“七夕”当做放松庆祝买买买的日子（又称大宋双十一）。
七夕节来临，全城的儿童和女子都穿上新衣，富贵人家会安排宴会以赏佳节，小姐姐们还会拉着自己小姐妹对月穿针拜祭织女、切磋女红、喜蛛乞巧、投针验巧。此外，街上商贾还卖应时商品“磨喝乐”（雕塑小佛像）、“水上浮”（用黄蜡绘或雕刻的鸳鸯、龟鱼等小动物）、“花瓜”（把瓜雕成各种花样）等等，可真是满目玲琅，应有尽有呢。
除了普罗大众，宋朝文人墨客也在七夕之际疯狂上分，光是关于七夕的诗词，宋朝就写了超过了两百首，干脆来一首秦观哥哥的《鹊桥仙·纤云弄巧》给大家节日助兴叭：
纤云弄巧，飞星传恨，银汉迢迢暗度。金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数。
柔情似水，佳期如梦，忍顾鹊桥归路。两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42415861/1f72d70071a84f34f8deac22fac0eb4abf434e78.jpg[/img]

现庆人间七夕佳令，再次祝所有的玩家朋友们（无论有没有对象），七夕快乐！一起期待二测的到来吧~
